mechanism_narrative: Sustained falls in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicate collapsing commuting and workplace activity, which removes the weekday footfall that supports retail-and-recreation venues, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below -15.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility reflects households sheltering at home, which directly substitutes for discretionary out-of-home retail and recreation trips, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above +5.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in PARKS below -15 signals cancellation of outdoor recreation, and because parks visits often accompany nearby retail trips, RETAIL_REC declines within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after PARKS prints below -15.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in GROCERY_PHARM above +5 indicates panic stockpiling under imminent lockdown policy, which pre-empts discretionary retail spending and pulls RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher over the next 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +5.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of falling TRANSIT and rising RESIDENTIAL signals broad lockdown compliance, which amplifies the withdrawal from retail-and-recreation venues and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall when TRANSIT declines and RESIDENTIAL rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A WORKPLACES reading below -10 indicates a large share of workers have left offices, reducing lunchtime and after-work retail footfall, which drags RETAIL_REC lower within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after WORKPLACES falls below -10.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where RESIDENTIAL exceeds +5 and PARKS is below -10, government restrictions are binding on both home and outdoor activity, forcing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days when RESIDENTIAL > 5 and PARKS < -10.

mechanism_narrative: The normal March uplift in outdoor activity is absent: PARKS fell from +2.1 to -5.3 over the last four weeks, removing a seasonal source of retail footfall and keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 7 days while PARKS remains below 0.
